mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the transport compression codec, chosen because it compresses better than the previous choice and decompresses much faster on both ends of the connection.

cat docs/policies/compression.md

The decision comes from Muninn record #5, which the user stated directly and which is still current.

The Muninn session hook also reported a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That points to a hook exceeding its timeout. I didn't investigate it.
